This here's the great Patrick's castle. Beat it.

I'm sleepy. And I'm in a lousy mood.

Strange one, ain't ya? Eh, whatever.

en: It ain't half bad in this cage, y'know.
I get my meals for free, after all.
Course, ya can't see the outside
Hey, thanks for comin'. 'Preciate it.
I hear somethin' big's goin' on out there?
Some nut carvin' up pretty gals with a knife.
Some folks do awful things, huh.
Next to that, my thievin's nothin', right?
I hope my daughter's all right
Say, that case... it's been eatin' at me.
I'll be gettin' out soon, but
I'm worried about my girl... Look into it
O little one, tormented by your fears,
you need fret no longer.
Live on as my servant.
note: No used_in; probably the third line of msg 33918 after #1063 (decoder loses it).

en: This too is salvation, in my own fashion. Hahaha
...What is it?
Pleased to meet you, Patrick.
Haaa! 'Pleased to meet you,' he says to a con!
Plannin' on movin' in behind these bars, eh?
Heh heh, kiddin', just kiddin'.
Eh, whatever. Hang in there. See ya.
Get it? That's me doin' the shitty mayor.
note: After #1016/#1017 + pause + #152 '...'; matches M2#1018 (slice 012), 'shitty' keeps the full strength.

en: <Why are you in prison?>
<How many years have you been here?>
Maybe they don't need a guy like me now...
What? Quit lookin' at me.
To be given orders by my master,
what an honor...
I just can't shake this tiredness.
And the work isn't even all that hard.
Command me as you will
My hands are numb. I can hardly do my work.
And there's this wound. I haven't a clue how
Oh, good morning.
You're up early.
You are rather early yourself.
Yes, well, I've got work to do.
Can't afford to lie about in bed.
I'm Darrell, a tailor. And you are?
I see. Well, see you another time.
Oh, we meet again.
Oh! Good morning.
How are you? Keeping well?
Me, I'm the same as ever.
You're looking well. I'm glad.
I'm feeling pretty good myself.
And work's going well, too.
Let's both stay healthy, day after day!
Oh, good evening.
There are no streetlamps here. It's not safe.
Do be careful.
Ah, yes, it is certainly dark.
I thank you for the warning.
On your way home from work?
Yes, that's right. I'm off home to supper.
I see. Well, take care.
Get home soon, or your family will worry.
Oops, I'd better hurry home too, or the wife'll...
Good evening. I trust you're well.
note: Shared with Bridget msg 292483 (new line after name + #7392).

en: You're a funny one. You seem livelier at night.
I'll be heading home now. Bye.
! Well, hello there!

Yes.

Yes, thankfully.
I've got someone waiting for me at home.
Well then,
